run_ik_fast_cli: run the IK solver CLI to compute robot hand joint positions from hand keypoints and object trajectories
run_ik_fast_bimanual: run IK for a bimanual xhand robot on the pick_spoon_bowl task with video output enabled
run_ik_fast_custom_costs: run IK with custom wrist position cost 0.5 and finger position cost 20.0 for tighter tracking
run_ik_fast_frame_range: run IK on frames 100 to 500 of the oakink dataset using start_idx and end_idx arguments
run_ik_fast_viewer: run IK with the MuJoCo viewer enabled to visualize the robot hand solving inverse kinematics in real time
